inputs.name: grafana_version
inputs.description: Grafana OSS release to install, such as "13.3.0". Raising it upgrades Grafana in place.

inputs.name: admin_password
inputs.description: Password for Grafana's admin user. Pass it at run time with -var or TF_VAR_admin_password; it never reaches state or the plan.

inputs.name: http_addr
inputs.description: IP address Grafana listens on, its [server] http_addr. "0.0.0.0" listens on every address.

inputs.name: http_port
inputs.description: Port Grafana listens on, its [server] http_port.

inputs.name: domain
inputs.description: [server] domain, the name people reach Grafana by, such as "grafana.example.com". When null, Grafana's default, localhost.

inputs.name: root_url
inputs.description: [server] root_url, the full URL people reach Grafana at, such as "https://grafana.example.com/". Set it when Grafana sits behind a proxy. When null, Grafana builds it from domain and http_port.

inputs.name: analytics
inputs.description: Send Grafana Labs anonymous usage statistics and check grafana.com for new versions of Grafana and plugins.

inputs.name: settings
inputs.description: More grafana.ini settings, by section, such as { users = { default_theme = "light" } }. Changing them restarts Grafana.

inputs.name: datasources
inputs.type:
list(object({
    name       = string
    type       = string
    url        = string
    access     = optional(string, "proxy")
    is_default = optional(bool, false)
    uid        = optional(string)
    json_data  = optional(any)
  }))
inputs.description: Datasources to provision, such as [{ name = "Prometheus", type = "prometheus", url = "http://127.0.0.1:9090", is_default = true }]. One removed from the list is removed from Grafana.

inputs.name: dashboards_dir
inputs.description: Local directory of dashboard JSON files, such as "${path.root}/dashboards". Each *.json file is copied to each host and provisioned. When null, no dashboards.
